agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Approval of the Annual Report and ratification of the consolidated financial statements for fiscal year 2025, with full release of responsibility to Directors and Commissioners. Approved with 99.993% votes in favor, quorum 100%; auditor was Purwanto Susanti & Surja (EY member firm), report dated 30 March 2026.
Agenda #2: Determination of use of company profits for fiscal year 2025, approving a total cash dividend of Rp196,507,200,000 (Rp12.00 per share), comprising an interim dividend of Rp2.50 per share (paid 29 August 2025) and a final dividend of Rp9.50 per share, with remaining profit as retained earnings. Approved with 99.962% votes in favor, quorum 100%; no mandatory reserve set aside.
Agenda #3: Appointment of Public Accountant to audit the financial statements for fiscal year 2026, delegating authority to the Board of Commissioners to appoint the firm and determine audit fees. Approved with 99.392% votes in favor, quorum 100%.
Agenda #4: Determination of salary and benefits for Directors and honorarium for the Board of Commissioners, setting a maximum honorarium of Rp16,000,000,000 (before tax) for 2026 and authorizing the Board of Commissioners to distribute it and set Director remuneration. Approved with 99.396% votes in favor, quorum 100%.
Agenda #5: Ratification of the report on use of proceeds from the Sustainable Public Offering Sukuk Ijarah Berkelanjutan I Samudera Indonesia Phase II Year 2025. This was a reporting item only, with no voting; result marked "Setuju" (approved as reporting item), quorum 100% with 0 votes for setuju/tidak setuju/abstain.
Agenda #6: Approval of amendment to the Articles of Association to align with BPS Regulation No. 7 of 2025 (KBLI 2025), updating Article 3 to specify main business activity as domestic sea transport for general goods (KBLI 2025 No. 50121) and supporting activities. Approved with 96.823% votes in favor, 3.177% not approve, 0.004% abstain, quorum 100%; authority delegated to Directors to execute the amendment.
